name: s81hd_lane_p4a

job.purpose: S81.HEAD.LANE: head-die lane block as cluster (CLOSED s8ng lane child + static adapter), frozen interface, to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0). MAIN

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered, unchanged RTL (release freeze): tx_d -> txd_p, tx_v -> 2 kept ot_s81hd_kf pin flops, rx_v / rx_d / flt leave flops (rv_q / rd_q / flt_q); rx / tx / chb are wires to the CLOSED child's own pin registers (lr landing, gearbox beat, endpoint chb flop). A recipe pin stage would change the frozen latency contract.

reset_landing.reason: rst_n lands in 2 ck flops at the core face, then ot_rst_relay_tree3 (35 slice leaves + lane + rx + misc, every leaf <= ~32 reset pins); the child lands its own rs (tree3 inside the closed view)

fill_reason.pin_bound: child-bound: the CLOSED 725.76 x 583.2 lane view + a 43.2-um ring + the adapter band; parent std ~2.6k um2 (adapter 3-flit buffer in 35 kept slices + pin flops) in the band; never shrink.

structural_change: s81hd_lane_p4a (STW-S81c-COLLA 10-22): p3m geometry; spine child insertion target 743.4 ps (was TT boundary mean 698.4): p3m/p3f measured TT spread 28 but FF 106-115 because the CLOSED lane child scales FF/TT 0.81 vs the parent spine 0.75 -> target shifted so the child sits early at TT and late at FF by about the same amount (both < 80 expected). RTL/ports unchanged.
child_clock_ref_reason: the parent adapter talks to the child's boundary pin registers (lo_* landing, li_* sender, W-face rx/tx flops): target = the child's routed boundary insertion (insertion.json TT mean 698.4), not its deepest leaf

slot_change_request.reason: H10 reserve ln_* is 518.4 x 1123.2 R0; the closed lane child is 725.76 x 583.2 (no R90 for SRAM views), so the head die re-slots the 13 lanes to 898.56 x 669.6 (area 0.602 mm2 vs 0.582 reserve). Ports / widths / protocol / cycles unchanged (freeze). Faces: SerDes rx/tx on W (MY for the E-SerDes lanes); core tx_d/rx_d/v/flt/ck/rst_n/chb on E (as m/f).
